package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

type TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository struct{ Pool *pgxpool.Pool }

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) Enqueue(ctx context.Context, input repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffEnqueue, now time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	intent, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(input.Intent)
	coordinatorOrigin := strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID) != "" || strings.TrimSpace(input.ClaimToken) != ""
	if store.Pool == nil || err != nil || now.IsZero() ||
		(coordinatorOrigin && (!validUUIDString(input.EventID) || !validUUIDString(input.ClaimToken) || !validUUIDString(intent.SourceTeacherJobID) || !validUUIDString(intent.SourceInteractionID))) ||
		(!coordinatorOrigin && (input.EventID != "" || input.ClaimToken != "" || intent.SourceTeacherJobID != "" || intent.SourceInteractionID != "")) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	tx, err := store.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	if err := lockOnboardingDialog(ctx, tx, intent.DialogID); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	var coordinatorMode string
	if coordinatorOrigin {
		var jobID, interactionID string
		err = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT job.teacher_job_id::text,turn.interaction_id::text,turn.coordinator_mode
FROM teacher_dialog_job AS job
JOIN teacher_onboarding_turn AS turn ON turn.teacher_job_id=job.teacher_job_id
WHERE job.event_id=$1 AND job.claim_token=$2 AND job.status='processing'
  AND job.student_id=$3 AND job.personal_teacher_id=$4 AND job.dialog_id=$5
  AND turn.stage='student_staged' AND turn.student_effect_state='accepted'
FOR UPDATE OF job,turn
`, input.EventID, input.ClaimToken, intent.StudentID, intent.PersonalTeacherID, intent.DialogID).Scan(&jobID, &interactionID, &coordinatorMode)
		if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherDialogLeaseLost
		}
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
		}
		if jobID != intent.SourceTeacherJobID || interactionID != intent.SourceInteractionID ||
			(coordinatorMode != string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction) && coordinatorMode != string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText)) {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
	}
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (
 handoff_intent_id,student_id,personal_teacher_id,dialog_id,source_teacher_job_id,source_interaction_id,
 command_id,command_teacher_job_id,request_hash,state_ref_kind,state_ref_version,
 goal_code,goal_version,graph_version,locale,status,next_attempt_at,notification_command_id,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,NULLIF($5,'')::uuid,NULLIF($6,'')::uuid,$7,$8,$9,$10,$11,$12,$13,$14,$15,'queued',$16,$17,$18,$18)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
`, intent.ID, intent.StudentID, intent.PersonalTeacherID, intent.DialogID, intent.SourceTeacherJobID, intent.SourceInteractionID,
		intent.CommandID, intent.CommandTeacherJobID, intent.RequestHash, intent.StateRef.Kind, intent.StateRef.Version,
		intent.Goal.Code, intent.Goal.Version, intent.Goal.GraphVersion, intent.Locale, intent.NextAttemptAt, intent.NotificationCommandID, intent.CreatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	created := command.RowsAffected() == 1
	stored, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(tx.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+`
WHERE student_id=$1 AND state_ref_kind=$2 AND state_ref_version=$3
FOR UPDATE
`, intent.StudentID, intent.StateRef.Kind, intent.StateRef.Version))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	if !sameTeacherOnboardingHandoffIdentity(stored, intent) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	if coordinatorOrigin {
		closed, closeErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_interaction SET
 state='handoff_pending',closed_reason='planning_ready',closed_at=$3,updated_at=$3
WHERE interaction_id=$1 AND reserved_teacher_job_id=$2 AND state='reserved'
`, intent.SourceInteractionID, intent.SourceTeacherJobID, now.UTC())
		if closeErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, closeErr
		}
		if closed.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		released, releaseErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET coordinator_mode=$3,status='queued',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,
 error_code=NULL,next_attempt_at=$4,updated_at=$4
WHERE event_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='processing' AND response_body IS NULL AND decision_id IS NULL
`, input.EventID, input.ClaimToken, coordinatorMode, now.UTC())
		if releaseErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, releaseErr
		}
		if released.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherDialogLeaseLost
		}
	} else {
		interaction, found, findErr := scanOptionalTeacherOnboardingInteraction(tx.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingInteractionColumns+`
WHERE dialog_id=$1 AND personal_teacher_id=$2 AND state IN ('active','reserved')
  AND (NULLIF($3,'')::uuid IS NULL OR interaction_id=NULLIF($3,'')::uuid)
ORDER BY created_at DESC,interaction_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
`, intent.DialogID, intent.PersonalTeacherID, intent.SourceInteractionID))
		if findErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, findErr
		}
		if found {
			if intent.SourceInteractionID != "" && interaction.ID != intent.SourceInteractionID {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
			}
			if interaction.State == domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
			}
			var actionPending bool
			if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_action_receipt
 WHERE dialog_id=$1 AND personal_teacher_id=$2 AND source_message_id=$3 AND source_message_version=$4
   AND status IN ('claimed','applied','materialized'))
`, intent.DialogID, intent.PersonalTeacherID, interaction.PromptMessageID, interaction.PromptMessageVersion).Scan(&actionPending); err != nil {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
			}
			if actionPending {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingBusy
			}
			if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_interaction SET state='closed',closed_reason='planning_ready',closed_at=$2,updated_at=$2
WHERE interaction_id=$1 AND state='active'
`, interaction.ID, now.UTC()); err != nil {
				return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
			}
		}
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	return stored, created, nil
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) GetByStudentState(ctx context.Context, studentID string, stateRef domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef, goal domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(studentID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+`
WHERE student_id=$1 AND state_ref_kind=$2 AND state_ref_version=$3
`, studentID, stateRef.Kind, stateRef.Version))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	if err == nil && intent.Goal != goal {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	return intent, err == nil, err
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) FindOnlyRecoverableHandoffForStudent(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(studentID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+`
WHERE handoff_intent_id IN (
 SELECT handoff.handoff_intent_id
 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff AS handoff
 WHERE handoff.student_id=$1 AND handoff.status <> 'blocked' AND (
   (handoff.source_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND handoff.source_interaction_id IS NULL)
   OR EXISTS (
     SELECT 1
     FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction AS source_interaction
     JOIN teacher_dialog_job AS source_job ON source_job.teacher_job_id=handoff.source_teacher_job_id
     WHERE source_interaction.interaction_id=handoff.source_interaction_id
       AND source_interaction.session_schema_version=3
       AND source_interaction.state IN ('handoff_pending','completed')
       AND source_job.teacher_job_id=source_interaction.reserved_teacher_job_id
       AND source_job.coordinator_mode=source_interaction.reservation_mode
       AND ((source_interaction.state='handoff_pending' AND source_job.status='queued')
         OR (source_interaction.state='completed' AND source_job.status='delivered'))
       AND source_interaction.student_id=handoff.student_id
       AND source_interaction.personal_teacher_id=handoff.personal_teacher_id
       AND source_interaction.dialog_id=handoff.dialog_id
       AND source_job.student_id=handoff.student_id
       AND source_job.personal_teacher_id=handoff.personal_teacher_id
       AND source_job.dialog_id=handoff.dialog_id
   )
 )
)
ORDER BY handoff_intent_id LIMIT 2
`, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent
	count := 0
	for rows.Next() {
		intent, err = scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
		}
		count++
	}
	if err = rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	if count > 1 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable
	}
	if count == 0 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	return intent, true, nil
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) GetBySourceSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, interactionID, teacherJobID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(studentID) || !validUUIDString(interactionID) || !validUUIDString(teacherJobID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+`
WHERE handoff_intent_id IN (
 SELECT handoff.handoff_intent_id
 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff AS handoff
 JOIN teacher_onboarding_interaction AS source_interaction
   ON source_interaction.interaction_id=handoff.source_interaction_id
  AND source_interaction.session_schema_version=3
  AND source_interaction.state IN ('handoff_pending','completed')
 JOIN teacher_dialog_job AS source_job
   ON source_job.teacher_job_id=handoff.source_teacher_job_id
  AND source_job.teacher_job_id=source_interaction.reserved_teacher_job_id
  AND source_job.coordinator_mode=source_interaction.reservation_mode
 WHERE handoff.student_id=$1 AND handoff.source_interaction_id=$2 AND handoff.source_teacher_job_id=$3
   AND handoff.status <> 'blocked'
   AND ((source_interaction.state='handoff_pending' AND source_job.status='queued')
     OR (source_interaction.state='completed' AND source_job.status='delivered'))
   AND source_interaction.student_id=handoff.student_id
   AND source_interaction.personal_teacher_id=handoff.personal_teacher_id
   AND source_interaction.dialog_id=handoff.dialog_id
   AND source_job.student_id=handoff.student_id
   AND source_job.personal_teacher_id=handoff.personal_teacher_id
   AND source_job.dialog_id=handoff.dialog_id
)
`, studentID, interactionID, teacherJobID))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	return intent, err == nil, err
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) HasHandoffHistory(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(studentID) {
		return false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	var found bool
	err := store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE student_id=$1)`, studentID).Scan(&found)
	return found, err
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) GetByPlannerHandoffID(ctx context.Context, plannerHandoffID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(plannerHandoffID) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+`
WHERE planner_handoff_id=$1
`, plannerHandoffID))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	return intent, err == nil, err
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) ClaimDispatch(ctx context.Context, claimToken, workerID string, now, lockedUntil time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(claimToken) || !validHandoffWorkerID(workerID) || now.IsZero() || !lockedUntil.After(now) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH candidate AS (
 SELECT handoff_intent_id FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
 WHERE (status='queued' AND next_attempt_at <= $1) OR (status='dispatching' AND locked_until <= $1)
 ORDER BY next_attempt_at,created_at,handoff_intent_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff AS handoff SET
 status='dispatching',claim_token=$2,locked_by=$3,locked_until=$4,attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=$1
FROM candidate WHERE handoff.handoff_intent_id=candidate.handoff_intent_id
RETURNING `+teacherOnboardingHandoffReturningColumns, now.UTC(), claimToken, strings.TrimSpace(workerID), lockedUntil.UTC()))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	return intent, err == nil, err
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) RetryDispatch(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken, code string, retryAt, now time.Time) error {
	if !retryAt.After(now) || !validHandoffErrorCode(code) {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	return store.finishClaim(ctx, intentID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='queued',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,
 next_attempt_at=$3,last_error_code=$4,updated_at=$5
WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='dispatching'
`, retryAt.UTC(), code, now.UTC())
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) MarkAccepted(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken string, result domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, now time.Time) error {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(intentID) || !validUUIDString(claimToken) || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+` WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, intentID))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff(result, intent)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	observedAt, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, result.ReadinessObservedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	return store.finishClaim(ctx, intentID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='accepted',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,
 planner_handoff_id=$3,readiness_observed_at=$4,accepted_at=$5,last_error_code=NULL,next_attempt_at=$5,updated_at=$5
WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='dispatching'
`, result.HandoffID, observedAt.UTC(), now.UTC())
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) ClaimNotification(ctx context.Context, claimToken, workerID string, now, lockedUntil time.Time) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, bool, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(claimToken) || !validHandoffWorkerID(workerID) || now.IsZero() || !lockedUntil.After(now) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH candidate AS (
 SELECT handoff_intent_id FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
 WHERE ((status IN ('accepted','active_path') AND next_attempt_at <= $1) OR (status='message_pending' AND locked_until <= $1))
 ORDER BY next_attempt_at,created_at,handoff_intent_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff AS handoff SET
 status='message_pending',claim_token=$2,locked_by=$3,locked_until=$4,attempts=attempts+1,updated_at=$1
FROM candidate WHERE handoff.handoff_intent_id=candidate.handoff_intent_id
RETURNING `+teacherOnboardingHandoffReturningColumns, now.UTC(), claimToken, strings.TrimSpace(workerID), lockedUntil.UTC()))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, err
	}
	if intent.SourceTeacherJobID != "" {
		job, jobErr := scanTeacherDialogJob(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT `+teacherDialogJobColumns+` FROM teacher_dialog_job AS job WHERE teacher_job_id=$1`, intent.SourceTeacherJobID))
		if jobErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, false, jobErr
		}
		request := job.Request
		intent.SourceRequest = &request
	}
	return intent, true, nil
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) MarkActivePath(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken string, now time.Time) error {
	return store.finishClaim(ctx, intentID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status='active_path',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,
 last_error_code=NULL,next_attempt_at=$3,updated_at=$3
WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='dispatching'
`, now.UTC())
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) RetryNotification(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken, code string, retryAt, now time.Time) error {
	if !retryAt.After(now) || !validHandoffErrorCode(code) {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	return store.finishClaim(ctx, intentID, claimToken, `
UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET status=CASE WHEN planner_handoff_id IS NULL THEN 'active_path' ELSE 'accepted' END,
 claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=$3,last_error_code=$4,updated_at=$5
WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='message_pending'
`, retryAt.UTC(), code, now.UTC())
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) MarkDelivered(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken, messageID string, now time.Time) error {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(intentID) || !validUUIDString(claimToken) || !validUUIDString(messageID) || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	tx, err := store.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	intent, err := scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(tx.QueryRow(ctx, teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns+` WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, intentID))
	if err != nil || intent.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffMessagePending || intent.ClaimToken != claimToken {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	if intent.SourceTeacherJobID != "" {
		job, jobErr := scanTeacherDialogJob(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT `+teacherDialogJobColumns+` FROM teacher_dialog_job AS job WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, intent.SourceTeacherJobID))
		if jobErr != nil || job.Status != domain.TeacherDialogJobQueued || job.ResponseBody != "" || job.DecisionID != "" || !job.Request.UsesDenseTeacherOrdering() {
			if jobErr != nil {
				return jobErr
			}
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
		var turnInteractionID, studentCommandID string
		if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT interaction_id::text,student_command_id::text FROM teacher_onboarding_turn
WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 AND stage='student_staged' AND student_effect_state='accepted' FOR UPDATE`, job.TeacherJobID).Scan(&turnInteractionID, &studentCommandID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var nextSequence, revision int64
		if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT next_teacher_turn_sequence,revision FROM teacher_dialog_turn_cursor WHERE dialog_id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, job.Request.DialogID).Scan(&nextSequence, &revision); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if nextSequence != job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence {
			return domain.ErrTeacherDialogCursorBlocked
		}
		command, updateErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_dialog_turn_cursor SET
 next_teacher_turn_sequence=next_teacher_turn_sequence+1,last_source_event_id=$2,last_teacher_job_id=$3,
 last_terminal_outcome='delivered',last_teacher_response_message_id=$4,last_no_effect_proof_id=NULL,
 last_recoverable_outcome_id=NULL,last_failure_code=NULL,revision=$5,updated_at=$6
WHERE dialog_id=$1 AND next_teacher_turn_sequence=$7 AND revision=$8`, job.Request.DialogID, job.Request.EventID, job.TeacherJobID, messageID, revision+1, now.UTC(), nextSequence, revision)
		if updateErr != nil || command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			if updateErr != nil {
				return updateErr
			}
			return domain.ErrTeacherDialogCursorBlocked
		}
		if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO teacher_dialog_turn_outcome (
 recoverable_outcome_id,teacher_job_id,source_event_id,dialog_id,teacher_turn_sequence,turn_correlation_id,
 outcome,student_command_id,teacher_response_message_id,no_effect_proof_id,failure_code,created_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,NULLIF($6,'')::uuid,'delivered',$7,$8,NULL,NULL,$9)
ON CONFLICT (source_event_id) DO NOTHING`, uuid.NewString(), job.TeacherJobID, job.Request.EventID, job.Request.DialogID,
			job.Request.TeacherTurnSequence, job.Request.CorrelationID, studentCommandID, messageID, now.UTC()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if command, updateErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_interaction SET
 state='completed',completed_at=$2,closed_reason=NULL,closed_at=NULL,updated_at=$2
WHERE interaction_id=$1 AND state='handoff_pending'`, turnInteractionID, now.UTC()); updateErr != nil || command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			if updateErr != nil {
				return updateErr
			}
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
		if command, updateErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_turn SET stage='delivered',updated_at=$2
WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 AND stage='student_staged' AND student_effect_state='accepted'`, job.TeacherJobID, now.UTC()); updateErr != nil || command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			if updateErr != nil {
				return updateErr
			}
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
		if command, updateErr := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET
 status='delivered',delivered_message_id=$2,teacher_response_message_id=$2,terminal_outcome='delivered',
 delivered_at=$3,error_code=NULL,updated_at=$3
WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 AND status='queued' AND coordinator_mode IN ('onboarding_action','onboarding_text')`, job.TeacherJobID, messageID, now.UTC()); updateErr != nil || command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			if updateErr != nil {
				return updateErr
			}
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
	}
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET
 status='delivered',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,notification_message_id=$3,
 delivered_at=$4,last_error_code=NULL,updated_at=$4
WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='message_pending'`, intentID, claimToken, messageID, now.UTC())
	if err != nil || command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) Block(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken, code string, now time.Time) error {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(intentID) || !validUUIDString(claimToken) || !validHandoffErrorCode(code) || now.IsZero() {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	tx, err := store.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	var sourceJobID *string
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff SET
 status='blocked',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,last_error_code=$3,updated_at=$4
WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status IN ('dispatching','message_pending')`, intentID, claimToken, code, now.UTC())
	if err != nil || command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT source_teacher_job_id::text FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff WHERE handoff_intent_id=$1`, intentID).Scan(&sourceJobID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if sourceJobID != nil {
		var jobStatus string
		if err := tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT status FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 FOR UPDATE`, *sourceJobID).Scan(&jobStatus); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if jobStatus != string(domain.TeacherDialogJobQueued) {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
		turn, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_onboarding_turn SET stage='blocked_unknown',student_effect_state='committed_unreconciled',updated_at=$2
WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 AND stage='student_staged' AND student_effect_state='accepted'`, *sourceJobID, now.UTC())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if turn.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
		job, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET status='blocked',error_code=$2,updated_at=$3
WHERE teacher_job_id=$1 AND status='queued'`, *sourceJobID, code, now.UTC())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if job.RowsAffected() != 1 {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		}
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func (store TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository) finishClaim(ctx context.Context, intentID, claimToken, query string, args ...any) error {
	if store.Pool == nil || !validUUIDString(intentID) || !validUUIDString(claimToken) {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, query, append([]any{intentID, claimToken}, args...)...)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	return nil
}

const teacherOnboardingHandoffColumns = `SELECT
handoff_intent_id::text,student_id::text,personal_teacher_id::text,dialog_id::text,
source_teacher_job_id::text,source_interaction_id::text,command_id::text,command_teacher_job_id::text,request_hash,
state_ref_kind,state_ref_version,goal_code,goal_version,graph_version,locale,status,claim_token::text,locked_by,locked_until,
attempts,next_attempt_at,planner_handoff_id::text,notification_command_id::text,notification_message_id::text,last_error_code,
created_at,updated_at,accepted_at,readiness_observed_at,delivered_at
FROM teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff `

const teacherOnboardingHandoffReturningColumns = `
handoff.handoff_intent_id::text,handoff.student_id::text,handoff.personal_teacher_id::text,handoff.dialog_id::text,
handoff.source_teacher_job_id::text,handoff.source_interaction_id::text,handoff.command_id::text,handoff.command_teacher_job_id::text,handoff.request_hash,
handoff.state_ref_kind,handoff.state_ref_version,handoff.goal_code,handoff.goal_version,handoff.graph_version,handoff.locale,handoff.status,
handoff.claim_token::text,handoff.locked_by,handoff.locked_until,handoff.attempts,handoff.next_attempt_at,handoff.planner_handoff_id::text,
handoff.notification_command_id::text,handoff.notification_message_id::text,handoff.last_error_code,
handoff.created_at,handoff.updated_at,handoff.accepted_at,handoff.readiness_observed_at,handoff.delivered_at`

type onboardingHandoffRow interface{ Scan(...any) error }

func scanTeacherOnboardingHandoff(row onboardingHandoffRow) (domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent, error) {
	var intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent
	var sourceJobID, sourceInteractionID, claimToken, lockedBy, plannerID, messageID, lastError *string
	var lockedUntil, acceptedAt, readinessObservedAt, deliveredAt *time.Time
	err := row.Scan(&intent.ID, &intent.StudentID, &intent.PersonalTeacherID, &intent.DialogID, &sourceJobID, &sourceInteractionID,
		&intent.CommandID, &intent.CommandTeacherJobID, &intent.RequestHash, &intent.StateRef.Kind, &intent.StateRef.Version,
		&intent.Goal.Code, &intent.Goal.Version, &intent.Goal.GraphVersion, &intent.Locale, &intent.Status, &claimToken, &lockedBy, &lockedUntil,
		&intent.Attempts, &intent.NextAttemptAt, &plannerID, &intent.NotificationCommandID, &messageID, &lastError,
		&intent.CreatedAt, &intent.UpdatedAt, &acceptedAt, &readinessObservedAt, &deliveredAt)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent{}, err
	}
	intent.SourceTeacherJobID = valueOrEmpty(sourceJobID)
	intent.SourceInteractionID = valueOrEmpty(sourceInteractionID)
	intent.ClaimToken = valueOrEmpty(claimToken)
	intent.LockedBy = valueOrEmpty(lockedBy)
	intent.LockedUntil = timeOrZero(lockedUntil)
	intent.PlannerHandoffID = valueOrEmpty(plannerID)
	intent.NotificationMessageID = valueOrEmpty(messageID)
	intent.LastErrorCode = valueOrEmpty(lastError)
	intent.AcceptedAt = timeOrZero(acceptedAt)
	intent.ReadinessObservedAt = timeOrZero(readinessObservedAt)
	intent.DeliveredAt = timeOrZero(deliveredAt)
	return domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
}

func scanOptionalTeacherOnboardingInteraction(row teacherOnboardingRow) (domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction, bool, error) {
	interaction, err := scanTeacherOnboardingInteraction(row)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{}, false, nil
	}
	return interaction, err == nil, err
}

func sameTeacherOnboardingHandoffIdentity(left, right domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) bool {
	return left.ID == right.ID && left.StudentID == right.StudentID && left.PersonalTeacherID == right.PersonalTeacherID &&
		left.DialogID == right.DialogID && left.SourceTeacherJobID == right.SourceTeacherJobID && left.SourceInteractionID == right.SourceInteractionID &&
		left.CommandID == right.CommandID && left.CommandTeacherJobID == right.CommandTeacherJobID && left.RequestHash == right.RequestHash &&
		left.StateRef == right.StateRef && left.Goal == right.Goal && left.Locale == right.Locale && left.NotificationCommandID == right.NotificationCommandID
}

func validHandoffWorkerID(value string) bool {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	return value != "" && len(value) <= 128
}

func validHandoffErrorCode(value string) bool {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	return value != "" && len(value) <= 64
}

var _ repository.TeacherOnboardingHandoffStore = TeacherOnboardingHandoffRepository{}
